title: fix(plugins): memory tasks fail after bundled plugin reload
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes memory searches and standing-intent maintenance failing with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` after a bundled plugin reload.

## User Impact

Captured Workers can keep importing shared host modules after reload and recovery. Ordinary reload remains available when a filesystem denies file symlinks; captured Workers requiring those aliases retain that existing limitation.

## Why This Change Was Made

The parent resolver preserves canonical host/SDK identity, but native Workers do not inherit its hooks. Publish host links for relative shared imports inside the owning captured package, and preserve source custody without copying a second SDK graph. Absolute imports retain their existing behavior.

## Evidence

- Actual Worker regression: fails with a missing shared module on the base, passes after the fix; also covers recovery after removing original plugin/Worker files, parent singleton identity, and shared-target preservation on disposal.
- Dependency-boundary and denied-file-link regressions both fail before their corrections and pass afterward.
- On integrated head `4f45f90755a9a245201a5df4682b3a44cdd30ade`: Bun 7/7 cases pass; Node 5/7 pass, including Worker/recovery, confinement and denied-file-link regressions. The two Node failures (`source-ts`, `compiled-cjs`) reproduce on the unchanged base and remain outside this repair. Earlier recovery/native-loader sibling checks also pass.
- Fresh independent P0–P2 review: complete, no findings after resolving the portability finding. Formatting and line-cap checks pass.
- Current official main was merged normally to preserve already-landed runtime fixes; the four task files are unchanged. The exact integrated candidate completed its native managed update successfully; terminal `preflight-build` exited 0 in 189.5 seconds. Live reload completed without a restart, actual memory Worker status returned in 1.47 seconds, and a browser tool turn completed once with correct output in 6 seconds. Integrated focused lint/typecheck, formatting, line-cap and diff checks pass. The unchanged original three-step memory dreaming scenario also passes on the exact native build: cron registration, recall/sweep promotion, and restored configuration/readiness; SUT before/after identity is unchanged.

Each new regression executes in under 0.3 seconds; total Bun case execution is about 1.9 seconds, excluding cold compiler preparation. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39881337458) and [Security Review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39881337824) completed successfully.
